summary: LONG-STAY DROP CANDIDATE (test 2): no operator page, no posted rate, no booking engine, operator domain hijacked. Cleared derived sewer (listing and a 2016 review say no sewer); added 50A (reported). No fees written: the only rate is RV Life's 2014-2016 $40. Phone confirmed.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE, LONG-STAY TEST 2: no nightly rate is posted anywhere from the operator, and there's no booking engine. The park reads as long-stay: imagery shows a dense grid of rigs with built-up sites east of Edgewater Blvd, RV Life's reviewer stayed on site 222, Campendium reports 210 sites, and Google's review summary quotes 'The place is catered for the permanent trailer tenants' and 'Didn't stay .it was run down and the restroom was very small', beside 'The atmosphere is peaceful, welcoming, and family-oriented again'. Seasonal share isn't stated anywhere, and I found no count of nightly sites.

GATE FACTS: posted rate none. Rates seen: RV Life $40 paid 6/2016 and 7/2014, avg_rate $40; Campendium 'last nightly rate $40'; all undated or too old to count. RV Life tier $$ (doesn't stand in for test 2 at a long-stay park). Good Sam: nothing stated. Gateway: none within 40 km (Cuyahoga Valley NP 52 km).
GOOGLE: 4.1 from 98 reviews, open, phone (330) 584-3695. Presence passes on Google alone. Summary lines are quoted above and read so-so.

WEBSITE: Google lists philabaunshiddencoveresort.com, but that domain now forwards to Banggood, an unrelated shop. The stored ohiocamper.com link is a directory member listing and the only operator-supplied text left (its 'Visit our Web Site' is presumably that dead domain). No other operator page found.

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (downward): stored lakeview, no evidence field in the dossier. On imagery the main rig grid is about 150-200 m north of open Berlin Lake (estimate from imagery) with brushy wetland between (leaf-off half of the mosaic), so no view from there. The rigs at the pin run beside a narrow wooded boat cove, about 50 m away through trees, and that arm is the 'hidden cove' rather than the lake. The listing claims 'wooded and lakefront sites', marketing only. No site map exists to tie numbers to positions.

CONFLICT: the listing says 'Dates of Operation 4/1 thru 10/15' and also 'Open April 25 to October 15', so season left unset. inclusion_evidence's 'full hookups' is contradicted by the listing's Sewer: NO. Pin is on the camp office area, within the park.
